reviewer: consensus_d fresh independent recheck after user reports for U+3D007 and U+3D034
scope: Read-only structural/proportion recheck of all sixteen glyphs, native PNGs and authoritative vector overrides; no art, font code, or glyph geometry edited.
criteria: Compare ALL available specimens at enlarged scale, rather than relying on prior pass labels or one specimen.
Explicitly compare each upper/lower horizontal length order and conspicuous relative span, not merely the existence of bars.
Count major descending legs, branches, short interior marks and distinct stroke endpoints per component.
Check upper partitions, closed counter counts, open bowl prongs and missing/extra enclosure dividers.
Check contacts/detachments and continuous versus separate courses while allowing one coherent attested whole variant.
Preserve current native form and proportions unless all-source evidence confirms an error; report ambiguity without certifying it.
For known rejected native PNGs U+3D032 and U+3D034, inspect their accepted manual vector corrections separately.

method.reference_enlargement: Each of four source columns cropped to glyph area and uniformly enlarged without changing aspect ratio; all four placed beside native and current source vector in read-only inspection composites.
method.vector_inspection: Current JSON centerlines rendered as constant-width black open courses for inspection. Small white raster specks in this lightweight inspection renderer are not treated as font counters or a statement about final compiled font rasterization.
method.artifact_mutations: Only this requested quality report and temporary inspection images created; no source glyph or review acceptance flags changed.

limitations: This is a focused visual structural recheck, not specialist paleographic certification, historical stroke-order certification, or a guarantee that no subtle form distinction remains.

Exact calligraphic dimensions and source ratios are variable and were not transcribed as design requirements. The clear U+3D036 length-order reversal is distinguished from uncertain proportional variation.

Source hashes at report write identify current files; if root applies a new U+3D036 override after the inspection, the finding refers to the explicitly recorded auto paths and inspection composite, not a later corrected geometry.
